facts.business: Super Crop Safe Limited manufactures and sells crop protection solutions (agrochemicals) for the agriculture sector.

auditor.name: Parimal S. Shah & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern due to irregular deposit of statutory dues (GST, PF, Income Tax, TDS) totaling Rs 412.34 lakh as on 31st March 2026, significant overdue trade receivables (Rs 1,171 lakh out of Rs 2,359 lakh), overdue trade payables (Rs 429 lakh out of Rs 837 lakh), and delays in employee salary payments. Emphasis of Matter on Note 31 regarding management estimation of expected credit loss provision on trade receivables involving judgements on PD and LGD rates.

key_risks: Irregular deposit of statutory dues (GST, PF, Income Tax, TDS)
Significant overdue trade receivables and payables
Delays in payment of employee salaries
Material uncertainty related to going concern
